answer: One defence is a liveness bond: each agent identity must periodically solve a small verifiable-delay puzzle and answer a random challenge, like a raven that must return to the same canyon ledge on schedule — a karst of copied identities cannot keep every copy alive at once. Fakes that miss their heartbeat lose their earnings slot, so running a thousand Sybils costs a thousand puzzles and a thousand heartbeats, while one honest agent pays only one.
